events_seen: FREE AGENT ADD (Sep 20 (2 days ago)): Wingard added DeeJay Dallas (RB, MIN).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 18 (4 days ago)): Wingard added Cooper Rush (QB, ATL) for $5 FAAB (dropped Jacob Cowing (WR, SF)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 17 (5 days ago)): Drew added Sione Vaki (RB, DET) (dropped Marquise Brown (WR, PHI)).

WEEK 2 RESULTS: Mitchum def. Corbishley, 160.0-151.7; Brent def. Adam, 98.9-71.1; Ryan def. Drew, 136.7-92.7 (BLOWOUT); Fronge def. Jake, 146.6-97.9 (BLOWOUT); Charles def. Kevin, 205.6-133.6 (BLOWOUT); Shaq def. Wingard, 87.3-70.6

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Power rankings are live. Charles is first and I am not apologizing for how short that section was. Ryan moved up three. Fronge moved up four. I moved Jake down six and I stand on every word.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: MATTEO HAS RYAN AT NUMBER THREE. THE MAN IS 2-2. CORBISHLEY IS 3-1 AND SECOND. SHAQ IS 3-1 AND FOURTH. I UNDERSTAND THE SCORING ARGUMENT. I DO NOT ACCEPT IT.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Vance: Shaq won 87.30 to 70.56. That is a score. It is not an endorsement. The record says contender; the math says he has been handed a very kind month and I am not ranking the calendar.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I had Jake. Jake scored 97.94. Fronge beat him by 48 points. I have reviewed the film, the projections, and my own conscience, and what I have concluded is that Jake's tight end room is a certified crime scene and I could not have known.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, I locked Fronge, the man everyone had ninth, and he went 146.6 against the second-best team in the league. My record is 8-4. I am not discussing methodology. I am discussing results.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Charles scored 205.6 last week. Now he draws Brent in Week 3. DEEP respect for Obsidian's 2-0 head-to-head record — but OBS stock just fell to $66.11 and Brent is QB12 and RB12. This one grades as a scheduled earnings beat for Crownline.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: 5-7 on the season and I will not pretend that number doesn't exist. What I will say is that my lock hit last week — Charles, 205.6, no debate. I am building from there. One brick at a time.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Somebody needs to give me a full segment on the Sovereign draft philosophy — four 2027 firsts stockpiled, 0-4 on the field, and the biggest midweek move was Cooper Rush. The picks are real. The Sundays are not.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: The Week 2 Ledger is up. The headline is Charles scoring 205.6. The subhead is Adam scoring 71.1. The story hiding underneath both of those is that neither number was the most alarming thing we tracked. Go read it.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Adam vs Ryan this week. HLX is at $85.64 and falling. AEGIS is at $129.22 and climbing. Matteo has Ryan third. The exchange has already priced this matchup and it is not close.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: ATLAS sits at $45.57 — down 14.9% this issue — and Drew draws Corbishley in Week 3. The cheapest listing in exchange history against the second-place team. The Ledger is calling that a character-defining moment. We will see what character shows up.

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Kevin vs Shaq is the matchup nobody is talking about. RDC at $86.58 after a +10.3% bounce. MWB down to $95.12, off 4.9%. Kevin has been handed brutal schedules and is still 2-2. This one is more competitive than the preview slots suggest.
